existing_instrumentation.cycle_source: hbnfCycles() wraps ESP.getCycleCount(); hbnfPerfFrameEnd() already retains start/whole cycles and per-frame scheduler, kernel, audio, color, overlay, companion preparation, DDP send, and unaccounted cycle totals.
existing_instrumentation.discard_point: hbnfPerfLatest is overwritten at frame end; enabled Packet20 tail telemetry retains only cumulative fixed-bin distributions and sums/maxima, so stage totals cannot be joined back to individual long frames.
missing_evidence: Monotonic timestamped individual frame records aligned to the >42.03125 ms tail frames.
Stage costs for those same frames, including DDP and unaccounted remainder.
A p99-level observer-on/off comparison; the preserved observer experiment measured average-frame change only.

minimal_trace_design.capture_predicate: Only when the already-existing bounded Packet20 diagnostic is enabled and a completed frame exceeds the frozen 42.03125 ms ceiling; store raw cycles, without rounding the threshold comparison.
record_fields: monotonic esp_timer timestamp in microseconds, read only after an outlier is detected
frame start/end cycle counts and raw whole-frame cycles
tail sample index, kernel id, and variant signature
scheduler, kernel gross, audio, color, overlay, companion preparation, DDP send, and unaccounted raw cycle totals
minimal_trace_design.storage: Fixed 32-entry single-writer ring in static internal RAM; approximately 2 KiB at a 64-byte record. Saturating overwrite counter makes loss explicit. Read only after collection is stopped.
minimal_trace_design.hot_path: No per-frame allocation, formatting, logging, HTTP, sorting, or per-pixel timing. The ordinary path adds only an outlier-threshold branch to the existing frame-end code; an outlier writes one fixed record. Existing per-stage cycle instrumentation is reused.
minimal_trace_design.diagnostic_boundary: The trace distinguishes an outlier dominated by measured application stages from one dominated by the unaccounted interval. A high unaccounted value alone does not prove Wi-Fi, scheduler, observer, or interrupt causality; that result remains unclassified rather than triggering speculative subsystem instrumentation.
minimal_trace_design.readout: After the bounded observation window, disable collection and fetch the ring once through the existing read-only telemetry response. Do not poll while measuring. Preserve a tails-off control window and compare the p99 distribution under the unchanged frozen gates.

measurement_proof.offline_functionality: Not yet implemented or tested; this document specifies the bounded record contract only.
measurement_proof.overhead_proof: Not established. The existing R7 measurement uses per-frame ESP.getCycleCount stage brackets. The incremental compare/copy path still needs exact pinned-target compilation/disassembly, fixed-memory verification, and host replay tests before any live diagnostic can be proposed.
required_offline_checks_before_any_live_: Compile the isolated trace helper with the exact pinned R7 Xtensa toolchain and optimization flags, not a replacement PlatformIO closure.
Verify disassembly has no allocation, logging, network, division, or unbounded loop on the ordinary frame path.
Measure exact record size, ring clear/read behavior, wrap/overflow semantics, threshold-edge behavior, and disabled-path equality with host fixtures.
Record target instruction/cycle delta for ordinary frame-end and outlier append paths; reject the design if the measured bound is material against frozen headroom.
Replay preserved R7 tail distributions and synthetic aligned stage records without treating synthetic data as historical measurements.

expert_sources.relevant_fact: Espressif describes cycle-count timing as lower overhead than esp_timer_get_time for short measurements and warns that cycle counters are per-core; the measured task must remain pinned. It also cautions about cache variation in small microbenchmarks.
expert_sources.application: Reuse the already-established renderer cycle counter and avoid per-frame wall-clock calls; read the higher-resolution timestamp only for rare outlier records.

expert_sources.relevant_fact: esp_timer_get_time provides a microsecond monotonic timestamp and does not use locking; its resolution/overhead differs from the per-core CPU cycle counter.
expert_sources.application: Use only as an outlier-only correlation timestamp, pending exact pinned-target overhead verification.

decision: No R8 build, device access, restart, OTA, or live diagnostic. Cause remains unresolved. Complete the stated offline measurement proof first; then seek new exact-artifact authority only if that proof and a source-backed correction/diagnostic requirement justify it.
